{{Intro/Quest|Road of Pilgrimage}}

==Summary==
In the depths of Truthseeker's Pass, you find the Cipher Key needed to unlock the Mianloong Chamber. Changli tells you that she has successfully fulfilled her mission to bring you to Jinhsi and chooses to stay behind to handle the troublesome Fractsidus.

You and Jinhsi return to Hongzhen, and with Xinyi's help, unlock the Mianloong Chamber. You discover that the Fractsidus has used a Court of Savantae creation to generate a special force field that prevents Jué from drawing energy from the chamber, effectively trapping it.

==Steps==
# Head to the Central Chamber
# Retrieve the Cipher Key
# Return to Hongzhen
# Enter the Secret Chamber
# Leave the Chamber
# Head to [[Mianloong Chamber]]
# Continue Forward
# Inspect the Hibernation Pod

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The hibernating deity silently awaits the pilgrims' arrival. To distinguish truth from lies, seek answers from this divine being.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(When player approaches the Cipher Key)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_242_1.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' The Cipher Key...
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, take good care of the Cipher Key.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I'm leaving the rest to you and Jinhsi.
:{{DIcon}} What about you?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_5.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Please don't forget: I am your Wayfinder. I journeyed with you into the mountains to ensure you meet up with Jinhsi.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_6.ogg}} '''Changli:''' From this point onward, I will be counting on you both to go and confront the Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_7.ogg}} '''Changli:''' This is all I can do for you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_8.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I'm here to guide, not intervene. The path is yours to choose.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_9.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Not to mention... the Fractsidus has been pestering us non-stop.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_10.ogg}} '''Changli:''' You'll need someone to keep them at bay.
:{{DIcon}} The Fractsidus are here for me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_12.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Yes, they've been constantly watching you, interested in your every move. They can never seem to take their eyes off of you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_13.ogg}} '''Changli:''' By all means, please carry on without me. As for myself...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_14.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I have a more fitting location to make my contributions from.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_245_15.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Oh, "speak of the devil"...
----
;(Cutscene plays)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_250_1.ogg}} '''Changli:''' How rude. This is not how we greet people here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_250_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Allow me to demonstrate the proper etiquette.
;(Cutscene ends)
----
:'''You leave the Truthseeker's Pass with Jinhsi on the Carrier Lift.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_255_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_255_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Changli...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_255_2.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. {{Rover}}, don't worry. Changli has her plans.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_255_3.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I don't believe we will run into more ambushes on the way.
----
;(When player is heading to the secret chamber)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_265_1.ogg}} '''Bing'ge:''' It's Madam Magistrate! She's back!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_265_2.ogg}} '''Bing'ge:''' I must go tell Lady Xinyi!
----
;(When player approaches Xinyi)
:'''Xinyi places the Cipher Key onto the Keyforge.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_1.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' The Mianloong Chamber is open now. You can proceed inside.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_2.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Before you go, there's something important I need to tell you.
:{{DIcon}} About how the Fractsidus imprisoned your Sentinel?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_4.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Changli was right. They used the Court of Savantae's research to trap our Sentinel in its resting chamber.
:{{DIcon}} How did they do it?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_6.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' They used the Chronosorters.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_7.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Our captured Artificer revealed that the Fractsidus sent a death squad to invade Mt. Firmament. They had a two-fold plan...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_8.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' First, to place the Chronosorter in the Mianloong Chamber while it was still operational; and second, to lure the Sentinel back to Mt. Firmament.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_9.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Although their death squad was no match for the Sentinel, by forcing its hand, the powerful Resonance Ability of the Sentinel would clash with the energy of the Chronosorter. This would ultimately cause harm to itself.
:{{DIcon}} Would that really make any difference?
:{{DIcon}} How could some Chronosorters trap the Sentinel?    
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_12.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' What if the Fractsidus modified those Chronosorters?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_13.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' A whole bunch of them, pushed to their limits, all working together to deliver one massive blow.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_14.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' But not even that was enough to take down the Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_15.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' After the first hit, they set up modified Flare Crests in the Mianloong Chamber to form a special force field along with those Chronosorters.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_16.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_17.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_18.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_19.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_20.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_21.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_22.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Yes, I will tell you everything.
:'''Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_24.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' So the Sentinel is actually injured, and it's been getting worse... The Fractsidus attacked while it hasn't healed yet. Their plans are devious as always.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_25.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Madam Magistrate, you've already laid out this plan so far.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_26.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' It's always a challenge to decipher the Sentinel's intentions, but there were many theories about it in City Hall at the time. I couldn't fathom why it went through such great lengths to retrieve you from Mt. Firmament and raise you within our walls.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_27.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' But now that I reflect on it, perhaps the Sentinel saw in you the potential to one day restore the Temporal Program and ensure the survival of Jinzhou's inhabitants.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_28.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' I just never thought.. You'd be willing to follow through with that prophecy...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_30.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' It was here on this very mountain that I first encountered the Sentinel.     
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_31.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Back then, I was too young to remember anything. Even the image of Mt. Firmament has slipped from my mind.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_32.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But this time... As soon as I stood at the base of Mt. Firmament, I felt a wave of recognition wash over me. Memories long buried resurfaced with sudden clarity.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_33.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Lady Xinyi... I was born with my life, my everything connected to our Sentinel.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_34.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But my duty as its Appointed Resonator is not the only reason for my decision.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_35.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...I'm following the heart of my younger self before I became Jinhsi: The girl who used to laugh with pure joy as she felt the snow from Mt. Firmament on her face.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_36.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I am a seed, born on Mt. Firmament, carried by the wind to every corner of Jinzhou. But now, I have returned to my place of origin.        
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_37.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' It's time for me to take root and grow into something greater...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_38.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Sigh... No matter what happens or what choices you make, please remember: the people of Hongzhen will always have your back.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_272_39.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Mt. Firmament has been stagnant for eternity. Perhaps a sudden crack of lightning is what we need to break through the fog of uncertainty that has lingered over us for far too long.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_275_1.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Once you pass through Hongzhen, keep your eyes open for a cave on the northern cliff. That will lead you to a shortcut towards Mianloong Chamber.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_275_2.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' The place is directly under Mt. Firmament's iconic Loong-shaped cliff. I wish you two the best of luck.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_280_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_280_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Jinhsi, so far, everything we know about the Sentinel is still just speculation.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_280_2.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' You are right. But my weakening Resonance Ability and my connection to the Sentinel leave me no choice but to explore these theories...     
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_280_3.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Whether it's fact or fiction, truth or a lie...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_280_4.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I have to confront the Sentinel and see for myself.
----
;(When player is heading into Mianloong Chamber)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_285_1.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' The Mianloong Chamber should be deep in the cave.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_285_2.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Let's go.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_1.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_2.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...This must be the Mianloong Chamber.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_3.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' We should now help the Sentinel break free from the Flare Crest's binds.      
:{{DIcon}} The water surface isn't moving at all.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_5.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Chronosorters nearby may have frozen this body of water in time, or it could be caused by the Temporal Disruptions here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_6.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Either way, we can use it to our advantage... We can walk over the water now. 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_7.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...We are too far away to see what's going on inside.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_290_8.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' {{Rover}}, let's go. I still need more information to determine what we should do next.
----
;(Cutscene plays)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_295_1.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I can feel the Sentinel's presence inside, but it's not responding...
;(Cutscene ends)
{{Dialogue End}}
